stem.text: The diagram shows an arrangement used to find the output power of an electric motor.
The wheel attached to the motor's axle has a circumference of $0.5\,\text{m}$ and the belt which passes over it is stationary when the weights have the values shown.

stem.alt: Electric motor with an axle connected to a wheel; a belt passes over the wheel with a weight of 20 N hanging from one side and a weight of 50 N from the other. Labels: motor, belt, wheel.

stem.text: When the wheel is making 20 revolutions per second, what is the output power of the motor?
